2.text:
<C:0001,0001,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0004,>～Volume 3～
[The Nightmare Begins]<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>History teaches that time and again,
across the aeons, good will always be
eventually beset by evil.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Evil soon came for Pi'illo Island as well.
An evil born of foul parents. Its mother
was corruption; its father, base cunning.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>It flapped into being and all trembled!
For it was the evil mage-king of bats,
and its name was Antasma.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>None know in what dark den it was
born or what nightmare byways led
it to Pi'illo Island's shores...<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>But once it came to roost on the
island, the fate of the peaceful
inhabitants was set in stone.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Though they knew it not, their
sandy footsteps now trudged down
the path of their own destruction.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,>Continued in Volume 4...
[The Two Stones]<C:0003,0001,>

3.text:
<C:0001,0001,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0004,>～Volume 4～
[The Two Stones]<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>Why had the evil Antasma come?
The answer: stones. For the Pi'illos had
ever guarded two precious stones.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>The first was called the Dream Stone.
Embedded within this wondrous stone
was all the power of beautiful dreams.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>There was another: the Dark Stone.
And within this slept all the power 
and danger of the world's nightmares.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Both stones held a terrible strength,
for they could fulfil the desires of
whoever held them.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Antasma looked upon the Dark Stone
with ravenous eyes and decided it
would be his and his alone...<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>By insidious means and black arts,
he spirited the Dark Stone from the
sanctuary where it slept.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>But he would not go unchallenged.
Dreambert discovered the plot and led
many Pi'illos to confront Antasma.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>They surrounded the stolen stone,
but the fiend would not yield, and the
battle was soon joined.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,>Continued in Volume 5...
[The Great Battle]<C:0003,0001,>
